follow100Note: Of every $100 of revenue, $88.16 came from Premium and $11.84 from ads. Direct costs took $68.91 and running costs $19.71, finance items cost $1.40 and tax took $2.46, leaving $7.52 kept as profit. Rows may not add exactly due to rounding.
footerNote: Spotify reports in euros under IFRS. Dollar figures are converted at €1 = $1.1196 (ECB euro reference rate at Sep 30, 2024). As reported: revenue €3,988M · gross profit €1,240M · operating income €454M · net income €300M.

oneTimers: Operating expenses included €54M of 'social charges' — Swedish payroll taxes on share-based pay that swing with Spotify's share price — versus €1M a year ago, and the charges came in €39M above forecast as the share price rose; €53M of the €54M sat in operating expenses.

Finance costs jumped to €122M from €14M a year ago, driven by a €67M fair-value loss on the Exchangeable Notes as the share price rose and €37M of foreign-exchange losses — which is why net income of €300M grew far less than operating income of €454M.
The quarter carried a €98M income tax expense on €398M of pre-tax income — a 24.5% effective tax rate — versus just €8M a year ago, when pre-tax income was €73M.
otherDetail: Finance items netted −€56M — €66M of finance income, mostly €59M of interest income on the growing cash pile, against €122M of finance costs, including a €67M fair-value loss on the Exchangeable Notes and €37M of foreign-exchange losses. A year ago finance items netted +€41M.

segments.name: Premium
segments.note: Subscriptions — 252 million people paying monthly, up 12% YoY; revenue per user (ARPU) up 9% as price rises outweighed product mix; gross margin 33.5%.

segments.name: Ad-Supported
segments.note: The free tier's advertising business — revenue grew 6% (7% in constant currency) on more ads sold, partly offset by softer pricing; its gross margin rose to 13.1% as music and podcast costs improved.

takeaways.text: Monthly active users grew 11% to 640 million — 14 million net additions in the quarter, 1 million above guidance — with growth across all regions, led by Rest of World and Latin America. Premium subscribers rose 12% to 252 million, 1 million above guidance, and ad-supported users grew 11% to 402 million.
takeaways.title: Record user growth

takeaways.text: Gross margin hit a record 31.1%, up 473 bps YoY. Premium gross margin reached 33.5% on music and audiobooks, and Ad-Supported gross margin rose to 13.1%. Operating income hit a record €454M, an 11.4% margin, versus €32M a year ago — putting Spotify on course for its first full year of operating profit.
takeaways.title: Margins hit record highs

takeaways.text: Free cash flow hit a record €711M, bringing trailing-12-month free cash flow to €1.8B and the cash pile to €6.1B. Net income swung to €300M from €65M a year ago, despite finance items swinging to a €56M net cost. Guidance for Q4 2024: 665M users, 260M subscribers, €4.1B revenue and €481M operating income.
takeaways.title: Cash piled up

verdict: Spotify grew revenue 19% to €3.99B (about $4.5B) and hit record profitability — gross margin of 31.1% and operating income of €454M, both records — as 640 million monthly users and 252 million paying subscribers each grew double digits, swinging net income to €300M from €65M a year ago.
